financing.summary: Signature Homes (SB Holding Corp., Hoover, AL) is a private, 100% ESOP-owned move-up and 55+ builder that self-develops much of its land, most visibly Everlee in Hoover, a 10-year master plan on more than 800 acres planned for about 2,300 homes with a $15 million amenity center. It has no public debt or SEC filings; HousingWire (Sept 2026) says it reports results to its lenders, but no lender, facility size or land-banking partner is named in public sources. Its ESOP held about $224.8M of employer stock at end-2024 against $44.2M of ESOP acquisition debt, so the company carries leverage tied to its ESOP. For a land banker it is a plausible but untested prospect: a profitable (H1 2026 net income $23.5M on $178.3M revenue), mostly presold builder with heavy owned-land and development exposure in Birmingham and new Nashville-area communities, and no public sign of lot-option or land-banking use.
financing.land_strategy: Mostly owned and self-developed in the company's own framing ('land to warranty'): it acts as master developer at Everlee (Hoover, 800+ acres, about 2,300 planned homes, started 2022) and buys raw parcels itself (24 acres at Riverwalk Village, Hoover, January 2025). No stated land-light or option target found.

lots.source_title: Bham Now: $5.2 million permit issued for work on Everlee Homes
lots.note: No company-wide lot count is public. Everlee alone is planned for about 2,300 homes on more than 800 acres (Bham Now, 2026-02-23); HousingWire (2026-09-29) reports 533 Everlee closings through June 2026, implying roughly 1,750 planned homes still to come there if the 2,300 plan holds (derived). Backlog at June 2026: 266 homes / $220.5M (HousingWire).

debt.instrument: ESOP acquisition indebtedness (Signature Homes Employee Stock Ownership Plan)
debt.source_title: Form 5500 (2024) Schedule H, Signature Homes Employee Stock Ownership Plan, sponsor SB Holding Corp. (EIN 47-1839874), filed 2025-10-09
debt.note: Schedule H shows acquisition indebtedness of about $45.9M at start and $44.2M at end of 2024, against employer securities of about $167.4M rising to $224.8M. The lender (typically the company itself under an internal ESOP loan, possibly backed by outside bank debt) is not stated in the extracted text.

capital_events.description: Company became employee-owned: Signature Homes Employee Stock Ownership Plan took effect (Our Story page says 2016; HousingWire and The Builder's Daily describe it as a full ESOP).
capital_events.source_title: Form 5500 (2024), Signature Homes Employee Stock Ownership Plan
capital_events.note: Plan effective date 01/01/2016 on Form 5500 line 1c.

capital_events.description: Bought 24 acres at Riverwalk Village, Hoover, from CR Endeavors for single-family and multifamily homes in a mixed-use, health-and-wellness-anchored development (Hoover Healthcare Authority); the luxury cottage/townhome community there began selling mid-2026.
